value.hook: Read before changing role lifecycle withdrawal, refusal projections or body-echo FYIs.
value.title: Role withdrawal authority and body privacy

sections.name: body
sections.value:
Role lifecycle and withdrawal review lesson from PR #135, source head 3621220 and final receipt-only head e60be54872a25b624f86e8961b04684ec27e8b45.

Edit, retire, merge and explicit drop-queued use the existing any-seat local directory-management authority. Do not infer a new holder-/prime-only restriction from examples of human/prime usage. This does not relax distinct authorities for lineage changes or output --answers, and does not create cryptographic per-seat authentication.

Withdrawal selects project + role + queued state across that role's instances. Delivering/delivered rows are excluded. Deletion and body-free role.request.withdrawn events share one DB transaction, but the prior Git role commit and later pointer/FYI operations are not in that transaction. Races, cancellation and notification failures can leave consistency work; do not claim global atomic cancellation.

Refusal output projects request ID, requester and age. Never substitute serialization of the complete body-bearing request row. Both withdrawal and FYI-held spine events remain body-free. Original body echo is only in the exact stored requester's local held FYI, with routing/control fields fixed. Opaque seat names are direct lookups, not role/remote addresses.

Actual notification granularity is one per non-self request, not grouped per requester; self is reported separately. Several messages from one requester can therefore produce several FYIs. This is a cost/consistency qualification, not a new disclosure by itself.

For private-run evidence, classify positive detector hits: generic temporary templates, parameterized loopback URLs, synthetic scratch identities, reserved-domain email and permitted own-project layout are not automatically private disclosures. Variable references to scratch key files are not literal credential values. Do not copy real sensitive candidates while reporting file/line/category.

The receipt script was inspected only as text. Code security, receipt fidelity and performance counts are different grades. Fake/unavailable ddocs and imported CLI differences in tested merge trees must stay explicit; they are not whole-tree validation proof.

Reports: .harness/government/community/roles/security/outputs/2026-11-06-pr-135-3621220-security.md and 2026-11-06-pr-135-e60be54-security.md.
